newsitem.title: CHINA: China's capital says has no plans to curb cars.
newsitem.headline: China's capital says has no plans to curb cars.

text.p: China's capital has no plans to limit the number of vehicles on its crowded roads, a Beijing official said on Thursday, dismissing rumours that have sparked a recent buying spree aimed at beating any restrictions.
Limiting the number of vehicles was not a good solution to ease Beijing's traffic jams, the Beijing Economic Daily said.

Congestion in Beijing was caused by a poor road network, backward traffic management and the violation of traffic regulations, it quoted Jiang Binjie, director of the Traffic Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security as saying.
Beijing traffic authorities had no plans yet to limit the number of new cars permitted on the streets of China's capital, an offical of the Beijing Public Security Bureau said by telephone.
Rumours of restrictions and new rules on vehicle registrations for some smaller cars have sparked concerns among manufacturers and a buying spree by consumers trying to beat any deadline.
